content.comment_body: I am looking for ways to access more data from the field-installed [product_name] compared to what the web browser interface provides. Are there any apps or SCADA systems compatible with [product_name]? I found mySCADA, but it does not support username and password authentication. Any suggestions?

Hello, have you considered using a VPN connection? With VPN, password protection is required for access. Once connected, you interact with [product_name] as if you were on a direct connection, which should allow your SCADA solution to operate effectively. Hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that the standard web browser for [product_name] does not provide enough data or access levels for SCADA use. There is interest in SCADA solutions that can offer secure access with user authentication. Some third-party tools fall short in meeting these security needs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a SCADA solution that enables comprehensive data access from [product_name], with strong user authentication and secure options for remote connection.
